wallet.history.penalty: The transaction failed; the fee was charged
wallet.utxoHistory.source: UTXO transfers between accounts, sent or received. The node keeps no list of them, so they are looked up in the network's block explorer, and each one it lists is looked up in the node: a sender, recipient and amount shown are the node's, and one the node does not confirm shows only its hash. A transfer the explorer does not list is not shown.
wallet.utxoHistory.noExplorer: This network has no block explorer to look UTXO transfers up in, and the node keeps no list of them, so they cannot be shown here. Keep the transaction hash of the transfers you send.
wallet.utxoHistory.loading: Looking for UTXO transfers… (this takes a while when the account has many transactions)
wallet.utxoHistory.none: The block explorer lists no UTXO transfers of this account.
wallet.utxoHistory.noneYet: None among the latest {checked, number} of the account's {total, number} transactions in this ecosystem.
wallet.utxoHistory.checked: Looked through {checked, number} of the account's {total, number} transactions in this ecosystem
wallet.utxoHistory.failed: The transaction failed; no transfer took place
wallet.utxoHistory.error.E_OFFLINE: Could not reach the block explorer or the node to load the UTXO transfers.
wallet.utxoHistory.error.E_INVALIDWALLET: This account address cannot be read.
wallet.utxoHistory.error.E_INVALID_RESPO: The block explorer returned a list this page cannot read.
